name: Logic Judge
postCreateCommand: (which g++ || (sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y g++)) && pip install -r requirements.txt && python scripts/fetch_data.py --max-gb 8 || true

GEMINI_API_KEY.description: Free Google Gemini key (aistudio.google.com). Used if no Anthropic key is set.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Optional. Paid Anthropic API key; takes priority over free providers if set.

APP_PASSWORD.description: Optional. If set, the app asks for this password (use any username).
